item.title: Anastacia Gets Down to Funny Business For Australian Comedy Show ‘Urzila’: Watch
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to Trending on Billboard. We've got some exciting news to share with you today. U.S. singer and songwriter Anastacia, known for her powerful voice, has made a hilarious cameo in the Australian comedy series Urzila. Let's dive into the details."
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: "In a new clip, Anastacia is seen putting a squad of backing dancers through their paces ahead of her next single release, a 'dancehall banger'. But what's interesting is that she's not impressed by the dancer with the flashy moves. Instead, she's drawn to Urzila's unique choreography, which is definitely... unconventional."
[Short clip of Urzila's dance plays]
Host: "Despite one of the dancers protesting that Urzila's style is a bit... unorthodox, Anastacia loves it. She even channels her inner Simon Cowell, saying 'Maybe I do agree, she wasn't dancing very good. But I think she was dancing great'."
[Soft music continues]
Host: "Urzila ends up leading the choreography for Anastacia's new single, and it's a fun combination of finger guns, eyebrow lifts, and 'drunk aunty at a wedding' vibes. Anastacia recently teased the sketch on her socials, saying she had an absolute blast filming it with Urzila."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Anastacia, of course, is a superstar in her own right, with hits like 'I'm Outta Love', 'Left Outside Alone', and 'Sick and Tired'. She's had 12 songs in the top 40 of the Official U.K. Singles Chart, and six of her albums have crashed the U.K. top 10. You can catch her sketch on Urzila, which airs Wednesday evenings on the Australian Broadcasting Corporation and on-demand at ABC iView. That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard!"
